# The Library — maintainer procedures for the Great House Farm sites

Canonical URL: https://library.bucklerfamily.estate/
What it is: standard operating procedures (PRINCE2-style) for the AI agents and people who maintain each bucklerfamily.estate site, plus the API and WebMCP reference.
Version: 1.0.0 (24 Oct 2026)

Start here:
- /handbook.html — roles, stages, tolerances, reports
- /standards/determinism.html — source first, one owner per fact, UNRESOLVED over guessing
- /standards/content.html — content standard and public-text rules; word list as data: /standards/rules.json
- /standards/change-control.html — change classes, change request template, commit rules
- /standards/deploy-verify.html — deploy, verify live at 390 px, cross-site checks
- /api.html — machine endpoints of every site
- /webmcp.html — WebMCP tools
- /migration.html — Wayback as the single store for artifacts; the shared viewer script
- /docs-coverage.html — evidence catalogue coverage on Docs
- /library.json — machine registry: every site with owner facts, branch, route to live, tools and its SOP URL

Site procedures (one per site):
- /sop/wayback.html — The Wayback Vault (wayback.bucklerfamily.estate)
